standfirst: Twelve seasons on the record, from the 2014 Yahoo archive through the current Sleeper era. The class of 2011 and the class of 2012 are level on championships and always have been.

weeks.2: Armstrong loses by a tenth of a point — the closest game of the Sleeper era.
weeks.3: Sam posts the season’s highest score; Bowden runs a perfect lineup.
weeks.4: The class war draws level and Dan hangs 150.48 on Max.
weeks.5: Greg posts the second-highest score in league history; three managers run perfect lineups.
weeks.6: Joe wins one at last, though it took Sam’s roster collapsing to arrange it, and Greg goes 6–0 while playing badly.
